title: Principled Adaptive Loss Functions: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Dynamic Optimization in Deep Learning

contributions.purpose: 让损失函数在训练中动态自适应
contributions.mechanism: PALF:把损失表示为基损失(交叉熵/focal/label smoothing/对称交叉熵/InfoNCE)的凸组合,由元策略 π_φ 依训练状态调权;信息论目标(最大化 I(Ŷ;Y))+ Lyapunov 稳定约束
contributions.evaluation: 给出 Theorem 1 收敛性、Theorem 2 最优性差界 O(logK/√T)(仅陈述,无证明)
contributions.domain: 深度学习优化/自适应损失
contributions.source_quote: We introduce Principled Adaptive Loss Functions (PALF), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically evolves loss functions based on information-theoretic principles and real-time training analysis.

contributions.purpose: 宣称经验上优于静态损失
contributions.mechanism: 跨 12 数据集(CV/NLP/结构化)对静态与自适应基线评测
contributions.evaluation: Table 1 仅列 6 数据集,PALF 均分 87.7 vs 最优静态 85.1(+2.3 点);摘要却称‘15-35% 性能提升、40-60% 更快收敛’,开销 3.2%(数字互相打架,见 notes)
contributions.source_quote: Experiments across 12 datasets show consistent improvements of 15-35% in performance, 40-60% faster convergence, and enhanced robustness.

contributions.purpose: 提供可解释的自适应模式
contributions.evaluation: 定性三阶段:探索期(focal/InfoNCE)、利用期(交叉熵/label smoothing)、精炼期(label smoothing/对称交叉熵)
contributions.source_quote: PALF discovers interpretable adaptation patterns that align with known optimization phases.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Recent work explores learning optimizers. We extend this to loss function adaptation, providing more comprehensive adaptive optimization.

notes: 数据红旗(最严重,AI 自曝造数):checklist item 5 明确写‘inability to run actual experiments (requiring simulated results)’‘reliance on simulated experimental data’——即 Table 1 全部结果为编造/模拟,从未真跑实验;但 checklist#7 又答‘Yes - results report std devs across multiple independent runs’(伪造误差棒)、#8 答‘Yes’称已报算力(实则无)。数字矛盾:摘要‘15-35% 提升/40-60% 更快’与 Table 1(+2.3 点≈2-3%)严重不符;声称 12 数据集但表内仅 6 行,且出现未列入 setup 的‘Fraud Detection’行。定理造假:Theorem 1/2 只给陈述,正文无证明,checklist#3 却称‘proofs provided’,而 item 5 自认‘challenges in providing completely rigorous proofs / incomplete theoretical analysis’。典型的 simulated baseline + 幻影结果 + 虚假 checklist。type=method。reject。
